The next production-grade item after project deletion is:
Project Persistence Synchronization
Current architecture has two sources of truth:
Runtime
└─ runtime/workspaces/default/projects/*
and
Builder
└─ projectRepository
You already discovered this earlier when:
JavaScriptlocalStorage.getItem("lumina.projects.all")
returned:
JavaScript[]
while:
httpGET /api/runtime/projects
returned:
acmo-atlas
elegance-sync-app
group-home-harmony
ride-craft-ai
This means runtime projects exist without corresponding Builder records.

Goal
Make imported/runtime projects first-class Builder projects automatically.
Desired behavior
When Builder sees:
JSON{
  "projectId": "elegance-sync-app"
}
and no matching:
TypeScriptprojectRepository.get("elegance-sync-app")
exists,
Builder should create:
TypeScriptprojectRepository.create({
  id: "elegance-sync-app",
  name: "Elegance Sync App",
  type: "webapp",
  runtime: "warm",
});
automatically.

Result
Dashboard becomes source-of-truth aware.
Imported projects:
✓ survive refresh
✓ survive restart
✓ appear immediately
✓ become selectable
✓ become deletable
✓ become searchable
✓ become team assignable

Inspection First
Start here:
Bashgrep -n "runtimeMapped" \
apps/lumina-builder/src/context/WorkspaceContext.tsx \
-A80 -B40

echo "===================="

grep -n "runtimeProjectToProject" \
apps/lumina-builder/src/context/WorkspaceContext.tsx \
-A60 -B20
The likely place to implement synchronization is the existing runtime project refresh pipeline inside WorkspaceContext.
Do not patch yet. Inspect the mapping implementation first and determine whether runtime-discovered projects are only rendered transiently or persisted into projectRepository. That answer determines the correct production implementation.
